verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a first-party public API for controlling docs programmatically, plus a Developer Metrics API and API-based export. The evidence consists only of one-line summaries and does not show how deep or complete the API is. missing for 10: endpoint-level documentation showing which product functions (pages, versions, OpenAPI definitions, settings) the API covers, documented authentication and usage details, and independent or hands-on confirmation that an agent can drive the product end to end through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Control your docs programmatically with the ReadMe API
See how people use your docs and how developers use your API
Export your docs using our built-in features, tooling, and our API.
